purpose: Accept native investigation Server prepared and confirmed ActionIntent comment delivery to two existing controlled fixtures, without making code or product conclusions.

executionScope.requiredDeliveryPath: The active investigation Server must create a prepared ActionIntent and confirm its exact version and payloadDigest before its production GitHub transport performs each POST.

nativeCorrelationMarker.construction: actionIntentPayload.body + two LF characters + <!-- agentic-review-action:<prepared intent id>:<prepared payloadDigest> -->
nativeCorrelationMarker.intentIdSource: Generated by the native Server during isolated preparation; no intent had been created when this initial draft was written.
nativeCorrelationMarker.payloadDigestSource: Computed by the native Server from the complete fixed actionIntentPayload using its canonical content digest.
nativeCorrelationMarker.approvedVariabilityRequested: Only the native-generated intent ID and payload digest in this exact correlation suffix may vary. Visible body text, drafts, finding IDs, action, repository, endpoint, and target must not change.
nativeCorrelationMarker.beforeConfirmation: Retain the prepared intent, its exact ID/version/payloadDigest, and the fully expanded outbound body. Compare its fixed payload and suffix construction with this approved draft before confirming. Do not invent an intent ID or bypass the native transport.

issueCommentWorkflow.spellingJob: Its guard requires a pull-request event or push event, so it is false for these comments.
issueCommentWorkflow.updateJob: Its guard requires a PR comment containing @check-spelling-bot, apply, and https://. Neither fixed body nor the native marker contains those commands, so the update job is expected to be skipped.

expectedIncidentalEffects: GitHub stores the two approved comments and emits normal notifications and issue_comment events.
The existing spelling workflow may record a run for each comment with its jobs skipped under the inspected guards. No manual workflow dispatch, cancellation, or settings change is authorized.
observedAutomationEffects.notEstablished: This read-only workflow inspection does not inventory third-party notification subscriptions or installed external applications.

unknownDeliveryPolicy.onUnresolvedOrFailedDelivery: Retain receipts and stop the run. Do not resend, create a replacement intent, delete comments, or perform compensating mutations. Another run requires new explicit approval.
